query:
SELECT id, rfqId, chain, status, htlcAddress, locktime, claimTxId, claimedAt, createdAt,
       FROM_UNIXTIME(locktime) as locktime_human,
       CASE WHEN locktime < UNIX_TIMESTAMP() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END as timelock_state
FROM htlc_swaps
WHERE htlcAddress LIKE '642LJ3L%' OR htlcAddress LIKE '642LJ3Lm%'
ORDER BY createdAt DESC;
